format.note: Quadruple round-robin: 10 clubs meet four times (36 matches). No split.
Double round-robin over 16 clubs (30 matches). The league expanded from 12 to 16 for 2026-27.

playoff.note: 15th plays a two-legged relegation play-off; 16th is relegated directly. The champion is promoted directly, with no promotion play-off.

boundaries.note: One club each way, both direct: the Prva NL champion replaces the HNL's last-placed club. There is no promotion/relegation play-off between the two tiers; the play-off at this level is inside the Prva NL (15th v a 2. NL club).

conflicts.detail: The HNL table marks only 10th as relegated. Older Croatian seasons used a 9th-place play-off against the second tier; that is not the current rule, so a sim that adds one will invent a fixture.
The Prva NL had 12 clubs from 2022-23 to 2025-26 and expanded to 16 for 2026-27. Our row says 16, which is correct for this season and wrong for last season.

conflicts.topic: Reserve team in the second tier
conflicts.detail: Dinamo Zagreb II plays in the Prva NL 2026-27 and cannot be promoted to the HNL (farm teams must stay at least one level below the senior side). The champion is promoted only if eligible; a second-placed finisher takes the place.

conflicts.topic: The HNL is a quadruple round-robin
conflicts.detail: With 10 clubs the HNL plays 36 matches (four meetings), not the 33 of the old 12-club triple round-robin. The 180 matches per season confirm 36 per club.

notes: Season 2026-27 in progress. Sizes 10/16 and levels match our rows. Prva NL relegation: 15th to a play-off, 16th direct to the 2. NL (level 3, not modelled). Cups and UEFA competitions excluded.
